visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with long brown hair tied back in a ponytail, wearing a beige t-shirt and a dark apron, stands in a bright, modern kitchen. She holds a white plastic container and opens it with her hands, which have white manicured nails. The background shows a white countertop and a clean, minimalist kitchen shelf with various containers. Large white text "來做晚餐吧！" is centered on the screen. (2) The character places ginger slices and small pork ribs into a stainless steel pot filled with water. She uses a measuring spoon to pour a clear liquid, likely cooking wine, into the pot from a white bottle. The induction stove is visible below. The kitchen has a neutral, warm lighting style. More subtitles appear: "普通家庭的 四菜一湯" and "川燙小排骨". (3) The scene shifts to the character squatting in front of a low cabinet, pulling out a container of rice. She pours the rice into a black inner pot of a rice cooker. She then washes the rice under a faucet in a stainless steel sink. Subtitles read "接著把飯煮起來" and "今天煮一杯就好". (4) The character prepares a corn cob and a white radish. She uses a vegetable peeler to skin the radish and a chef's knife to slice both into chunks on a pink cutting board. A spray bottle and cleaning supplies are visible in the background sink area. Subtitles include "湯的配料" and "白蘿蔔切滾刀". (5) In a shallow grey frying pan, she pours sesame oil from a yellow and brown can. She then adds sliced ginger and pieces of white fish coated in flour. The pan sits on an induction burner. A white pot with a lid is simmering in the background. Subtitles read "麻油" and "裹二種粉". (6) The character adds peeled shrimp and clams to a pan of cooked vegetables. She uses a ladle to pour broth from the adjacent soup pot into the pan before covering it with a glass lid. The kitchen remains brightly lit. Subtitles read "跟隔壁的湯借一點高湯". (7) She fries the fish until golden brown and stir-fries leafy green vegetables in a pan. Finally, she uses scissors to cut grilled pork into smaller pieces on a plate. The video ends with a wide shot of the completed meal: four dishes and one soup arranged on the counter. Final text: "回家吃飯囉！".

(7) [Subtitle]: 微波加熱. (8) [Subtitle]: 應該就夠了. (9) [Subtitle]: 湯的配料. (10) [Subtitle]: 是百搭的玉米和白蘿蔔. (11) [Subtitle]: 白蘿蔔切滾刀. (12) [Subtitle]: 自從學會了這招. (13) [Subtitle]: 切玉米變得很輕鬆. (37) [Subtitle]: 最有印象的是 我爸幫我選了大朵花的壁紙 還完工了那樣. (38) [Subtitle]: 超大大朵那種喔！(很土). (39) [Subtitle]: 我就不喜歡 後來我媽就直接幫我換了 我自己選的粉紅色小花壁紙. (40) [Subtitle]: 我媽說我從小就是意見很多的小孩. (41) [Subtitle]: 突然間覺得 哥應該90%像我. (42) [Subtitle]: 迴力標？. (43) [Subtitle]: 生養孩子這事. (44) [Subtitle]: 也是在幫我們回顧童年. (45) [Subtitle]: 回顧自己的成長經歷. (46) [Subtitle]: 好的保留. (47) [Subtitle]: 壞的就Let it go. (48) [Subtitle]: 回家吃飯囉！.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle splashing sound of water followed by the immediate start of an upbeat, acoustic-folk background music featuring acoustic guitar and piano. A female voice begins a calm, friendly narration in Traditional Chinese, explaining the goal of making a four-dish dinner. (2) A sharp mechanical click is heard as the character turns on the induction cooktop, followed by the soft sound of liquid being poured into a pot. The narration continues smoothly, detail-oriented and informative, with consistent music tempo. (3) Rhythmic, percussive chopping sounds of a knife hitting a plastic cutting board occur as vegetables are sliced. The sounds are crisp and clear, overlapping with the persistent background music and the ongoing voiceover narration. (4) A loud, sizzling sound erupts as food is placed into hot oil in a pan. This creates a broadband noise texture that the voiceover and music sit on top of. The intensity of the sizzle fluctuates as the character moves the food. (5) Bubbling and boiling sounds of soup are clearly audible, accompanied by the metallic clink of a ladle against a pot. The voiceover shifts into a storytelling mode, reminiscing about childhood memories while the music maintains a positive, nostalgic atmosphere. (6) Towards the end, the distinct metallic 'snip' of scissors cutting through meat is heard several times. The narration concludes with a warm, inviting tone, and the background music fades out gradually after the final sentence.

It aims to provide cooking inspiration while building a personal connection with the audience through storytelling.
